notes.title: Parasite Black update plan for 2025!
notes.content:
Hello adventurers! 


We wanted to take a moment to discuss some important news, changes, and hopefully clear up any misconceptions. 

Moving forward now, we plan to release a series of smaller, but steady releases as we build upon Act 2, both adding side content and continuing the main story. We think this is an incredibly exciting time to be a fan; it’s a lot of work on our part, but we think we’re building something special. 



The Release schedule explained:

We’d like to take a moment to explain how our release schedule works – This info/dates can be found in a thread for the community to discuss as well.

The way our release schedule works is that our patron supporters pay a monthly subscription (with different tiers of financial support) and receive the latest content updates first. These users help us with various bug-fixes so that when it arrives for Steam users, the experience is hopefully much more polished. Steam users then receive the update after. We want to stress that steam users receive ALL the same content. The tradeoff for steam users is that they only must pay once, but they need to wait a little longer, which we feel is the fairest system for everyone. 



Changes to the schedule: 

With that said, after taking on board some feedback. Rather than making steam users wait a full month like with this release just gone, steam players will now receive access to the beta 2 weeks from its beta launch and then access to the finished build one week after that – (3 weeks).



Current release outline plan for Parasite Black for 2025! 

Please note, all these dates are considered approximate – If there’s any delays for whatever reason, we’ll give the heads-up.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44562767/2db82090416c4512f34bf00583a6f28030320b19.jpg"]

Finally, we'd like to thank everyone for your support so far,

without your incredible support, none of this would be possible,

-The Damned Studios Team

notes.title: ⚔️ Act 1 Finale Incoming – Late June Release Target! ⚔️
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

After a lot of planning (and some second guessing), we’re aiming to drop the end of Act 1 update around late June!

We try not to throw out dates too early, because we’d rather avoid walking them back later unless we absolutely have to. That said, we’re making great progress — still lots of implementing and playtesting ahead — but this one’s definitely shaping up to be one of our biggest and most ambitious updates yet.

What’s in the Update?
A brand new city — The Free City of Hamun, full of new faces, story threads, and of course, trouble.

New characters, including Rania (the innkeeper at The Pale Dragon) and a new shopkeeper you’ll definitely want to meet.

Fresh lewd scenes — multiple, spicy, and tied into the story in satisfying ways.

Quality of life improvements — based on your feedback. We’re listening.

Major story developments — this is a turning point in the plot and sets the tone for Act 2.

New Art Drop
The artwork you see up top is by Aelty, one of our new artists, who’s been knocking it out of the park already. You’ll be seeing a lot more of their work in future updates.

notes.title: The Queen of Phalli - Coming soon!
notes.content:
In the dark depths of the realms below, power and status depend on passion and promiscuity. It is a world of wonders where only women dwell and the priestesses of the Queen of Phalli rule unmatched.

https://files.catbox.moe/ztfqwr.jpg
Young Elifael El'Naar must prepare for her Baptism, a perilous ceremony to prove her loyalty to her House and devotion to the Goddess. Should she succeed, she will have taken her first step to becoming a priestess herself. Should she fail, she may lose her status and even her mind.

https://files.catbox.moe/zmscdq.jpg
- Deep Narrative Immersion: Over 200.000 handwritten words, waiving a story that seeks balance between character development, plot, and overly abundant sexual content.

- Overly abundant sexual content: Elifael will not limit her escapades to her mother and sisters. Throughout her journey, she will meet exotic and fascinating creatures such as gnomes, goblins, centaurs, and even humans.

- Branching Choices: Elifael must fight for her sisters' affection and respect. Yet only one path can be walked at a time, so choose carefully.

- Multiple Endings: Will Elifael stay true to her faith or her heart? Will she choose a sister over the other, or will she be the glue holding her family together? Will she endure the baptism or will she lose everything along the way? You decide.

notes.title: Parasite Black – Dev Update
notes.content:
Hey guys, it's time for some official news!

New Artist Joins the Team

First and foremost, we've brought on a new artist to the project: Shamp Shamp! We believe they'll not only help speed up production, but also bring some truly amazing new art to the game. We're dying to show off their work to you guys! :)

Huge Update Incoming

On the development side, we're continuing to implement the script while gathering the remaining assets for the next update. Please bear with us a little longer — this upcoming update is one of the biggest we've ever put out (despite a few production hiccups along the way). 

There’s a lot to be excited about in this update, including:

- New lewd scenes (spicy content for our adult adventurers!)
- A whole new city to explore (welcome to Hamun!)
- Major lore drops in the main story (big reveals are coming)
- New OST tracks (fresh music to set the mood)
- Additional QoL improvements (for a smoother gameplay experience)

Keep your swords (and claws) sharp... 

Prequel Project: Dreams of Celeste

Meanwhile, development is also moving smoothly on our prequel game, Dreams of Celeste. We're busy gathering character models and other assets for that project as well. (More on that soon!)

The City of Hamun

Our new city Hamun is shaping up nicely! Our first goal is to make sure the city is at least functional (shops, basic services, etc.). Ideally, we want to include a few fun things to do in Hamun for this release, but how much we can pack in will depend on our timeframe. Once the city is a bit more stable and everything's working as it should, we'll share some footage of Hamun in action to show you guys. We can't wait to give you a sneak peek of this exciting new location!

That's all for now. But don't worry, more news and plenty of crazy things are coming soon! Stay tuned...

 In the meantime, what new feature are you most excited about? Let us know in the comments below — we always love hearing your thoughts. As always, you guys are awesome — you keep the lights on around here! 

Love,

The Damned Studios Team

notes.title: Progress Update – Act 1+2, Free City of Hamun & More!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We’re back with an exciting progress update on Parasite Black! This update is shaping up to be huuuge! There’s a ton of new content in the works, and things are coming together nicely. That said, with so many assets to prepare, we don’t want to lock in a release date just yet — but rest assured, we’re getting closer every day.

What’s Coming:
Act 1 – Our goal is to round off Act 1, setting the stage for the next big steps in the story.
Act 2 – We’re aiming to add a small portion of Act 2 as well.
Free City of Hamun – We’re working hard to make the Free City of Hamun fully functional, introducing new places to explore and characters to meet.
Barati Card Game – We’re hoping to roll out the card game Barati as a new mechanic — it’s still in development, but it’s looking very promising!

Regina Update:
We’ve started preparing Regina’s assets and received some spicy new material from the artist recently. However, the majority of Regina’s content will likely come in a later update, as communication with the artist remains tricky. We’re exploring all options and hope to have more news on this soon.

Moving Forward:
This update should bring a lot of new lore, exciting gameplay, and meaningful story progression. We’re genuinely excited about how it’s coming together and can’t wait to share it with you!

If you’ve got any questions, drop them here or join us on Discord, we’ll do our best to get back to you.

Exciting things are on the horizon!

The Parasite Black Team

From the bottom of our hearts, THANK YOU to everyone who purchased, played, and shared the game. The feedback, reviews, and kind words have been overwhelming, and it’s inspired us to push forward with even more excitement and energy.

Stay tuned for updates, and as always, let us know your thoughts—we love hearing from you!

The Parasite Black Team

notes.title: Progress Update: Combat Balancing, QOL Improvements & More! ⚔️
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

We just wanted to touch base and share some exciting updates on the development of Parasite Black. Things are progressing smoothly, and we’re thrilled with the progress we’ve made so far!

🎯 Combat Balancing:
We’ve nearly completed the first round of testing for combat balancing and refinement. Things are shaping up nicely, and we’re down to fine-tuning the last couple of enemies. We’re also hard at work on some much-requested QOL improvements! One of the big additions is optional easy and hard modes, giving players the freedom to choose the level of challenge they want to face.

🎨 Audio & Visual Tweaks:
Once the combat balancing is finalized, we’ll move on to polishing a bit more the audio and visuals. Expect some exciting improvements that enhance the overall experience and immerse you even further in the world!

✍️ Scripts and Art:
The team is continuing to implement the scripts, gather stunning new art, and ensure everything comes together before the release. It’s a lot of work, but it’s so worth it to make this game the best it can be!

https://i.imgur.com/3zMdUwq.png

We’re grateful for your continued support and can’t wait to share more as we move closer to release. Stay tuned for more updates, and as always, feel free to drop your thoughts or suggestions in the comments below—we love hearing from you!

Until next time,
The Parasite Black Team 🖤

notes.title: Developers Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Just wanted to drop by with an update on how things are progressing!

First and foremost, if you haven’t already, please make sure to wishlist Parasite Black! Every wishlist makes a huge difference, and with the release coming up fast, your support is more important than ever!

Mika Update Progress
We’ve gathered almost all the art assets for the Mika update, and once we wrap up some final technical improvements, we’ll be aiming to release it as soon as possible! In the meantime, we’re already shifting focus to gather artwork for the massive Steam release update. It's an incredibly exciting time for us—and hopefully for you as well—as fans of Parasite Black!

https://i.imgur.com/gEikRDf.jpeg

(WIP) Another chaotic scene from the second battle of Novaras.

Combat Overhaul
We’ve temporarily dismantled the combat system once again (don’t worry, it’ll be back soon and better than ever!) to address lag and improve the overall feel. The goal is to make combat faster and smoother, and so far, the results have been really promising.

https://i.imgur.com/UPsFT75.gif

The new default combat experience will streamline animations, leaning towards a Darkest Dungeon-style speed and fluidity. As you can see, battles are now much faster and more dynamic. For those who prefer the classic, full-animation experience, we’ll include a toggle option, though it may still cause some lag, as before.

We’re also finalizing new skills, balancing mechanics, and tweaking other details to ensure the improved combat feels just as satisfying as it did in the last update—if not better!

More on that soon!

Additional Updates
The script for the Steam release is well underway—it’s spicy, and we’re loving how it’s coming together so far!
We’ve also commissioned new music tracks and other assets.
Expect even more "plot" (in every sense of the word) to arrive very soon. 😉
That’s all for now. Thank you all so much for your ongoing support—you keep the team motivated and energized to keep doing what we love most!

With love,
The Damned Studios Team
https://i.imgur.com/S00v1Uw.jpeg

Mika can’t wait to try one of the new Alderian jawbreakers! (Just remember: Don’t bite off more than you can chew!)
